Agent Factory CLI theme assets

Source: https://github.com/CosmicHorrorDev/two-face
Revision: 33f7e243b6174e8f0c63fd7698ec5736d715e355 (0.5.1)
Artifact: generated/themes.bin
SHA-256: be28f0c1a167469c5bd1e5311d4d3503e6503b378791f2afb9e3e5f2f7f4642e
Regenerate: python3 scripts/generate-cli-themes.py

The JSON is a mechanical transcription of the embedded Syntect theme foreground,
background, scope selectors, and font styles into TextMate settings. CLI kebab-case
names replace display names. No palette substitutions are made. Eight-digit colors
preserve Syntect alpha markers: alpha 00 means ANSI index in red; alpha 01 means
terminal default; CLI treats other alpha values as opaque RGB.

Curation source: https://github.com/sharkdp/bat
Revision: 979ba22628bc9d8171f2cffca2bd5c90c9fc0a9e
Defaults: https://github.com/trishume/syntect
Revision: e4670846ecf16d8832db6c43d531bec466214e27 (5.3.0)
